name: Oyun-Rehberi Türkçe Oyun Bilgisi Veri Kümesi
format: JSON Lines (UTF-8), one JSON object per line
description: SSS kayıtları, rehber bölümleri ve kaynak bağlantıları korunmuş daha küçük iddia birimlerini içeren Türkçe oyun bilgisi arşivi.

limitations: Guide-section records preserve meaningful document sections. They are not guaranteed to be atomic single claims.
Claim-unit records are split at sentence boundaries when possible, otherwise at paragraph or list-item boundaries. They may still contain more than one proposition.
Claim-unit evidence and source links are assigned at unit level when present, otherwise inherited from the parent record.
This dataset is a starting point for retrieval and evaluation, not a claim of readiness for every model-training task.
Source links identify references but do not independently prove that each claim is correct.
